lens: intentional capture, provenance, account scope, retention, proposal and authority separation, truthful outcome, idempotency, and reversibility

findings.observation: The Web path is authenticated, account-scoped, synthetic, source-linked, retained under source-retention.v2, and localhost-only after receipt. The connected normal Chrome control timed out, so this round did not prove visible selected-text invocation, temporary activeTab scope, or pre-Submit network silence.
findings.user_impact: The downstream Web review can be safe while the integrated journey still lacks proof that evidence entered only through the promised user-controlled browser gesture.
findings.recommendation: Run the frozen extension in a policy-authorized visible Chrome profile without opening chrome:// pages during evidence capture.
findings.verification: One direct trace proves temporary selected-text scope, exact preview, pre-Submit silence, explicit Submit, and one account-scoped receipt.

findings.observation: Keyboard focus, repeated exact-source focus, state announcements, and stable light/dark axe scans are direct. No manual screen-reader session proves that spoken order keeps proposal, confirmed state, approval, unknown, and verified distinct.
findings.user_impact: A screen-reader user could encounter an unobserved announcement defect that weakens a safety boundary.
findings.recommendation: Run VoiceOver or NVDA through the complete authority and recovery path.
findings.verification: Spoken order and announcements preserve source, interpretation, confirmation, approval, unknown result, and verified readback as distinct states.

strengths: The handoff header and packet key are bound by one tested builder.
Evidence crop returns a truthful reviewed_selected_text receipt, source-access state, and 2026-09-04 retention deadline.

A dismissed required fact blocks authority, stale preview invalidates approval, and unknown result blocks repeat execution.
Capability revocation blocks approval and execution without rewriting an existing active approval; approval revocation remains available and no result is claimed.
No off-localhost request or external write was observed.
